Pickup: TJS-1245 operator binding r3

Inspection began after the dispatch sent-at `2026-10-29T12:02:34Z`. This acknowledges inspection, not privileged execution authority.

Gateway run ID: not exposed by the available current-session metadata or environment; unavailable, not invented. Gateway session is `b59ced92-733d-492c-bf7c-4fc7a4e04190`; actual Codex invocation is `01a1878a-83ab-72c1-8654-045bff0c33a1`. Neither is represented as a gateway run or borrowed Paperclip heartbeat.

Read the contract first, then helper and source manifest. Own node read verified clean candidate commit `ea2f2b0fdfa5ec0775fb3fbc5371afbfac15e18b` at `<repo>/.paperclip/worktrees/TJS-2504-meownero-isolated-shared-testnet-profile-and-bootstrap-launch-candidate`. Authenticated source-packet read verified attachment `5a5b4a7b-0cb6-40f1-8ca2-0ebd22fce41d`, 1,076,859 bytes, SHA256 `5281c05a950fc692542d58effc70bba335b45de9822e4e7fbacae9dcfa951b05`.

## 1. Privileged operator and authority answer

**No specifically named, acknowledged privileged operator for these three operations is established by the inspected authority records.** The observed login `tjmehta` is an OS identity, not an authorization binding. OpenClaw acknowledges only this read-only handback. The Paperclip board identity `local-board` authorizes the requested receipt transport, not host root operations.

Authority provenance checked:
- TJ, WhatsApp `3A5E29238482C96B9BEA`, 2026-10-27 08:42:04Z, “Get it going,” preserved verbatim in [TJS-2941](<private-tracker>/TJS/issues/TJS-2941). This resumes existing test-distribution/non-public-candidate delivery; it does not name a privileged operator or grant the three host operations.
- [TJS-2504 comment c78e1c2c](<private-tracker>/TJS/issues/TJS-2504#comment-c78e1c2c-262f-41fb-9f1e-6e3ef52ca45d), 2026-10-27: source-only continuation; stop at a necessary privileged primitive and identify its owner.
- [Consolidated decision a5ec64fd](<private-tracker>/TJS/issues/TJS-2504#comment-a5ec64fd-3da7-4044-8863-795ef7a6541f), 2026-10-29, and request revision 3 explicitly withhold activation/setup and say no privileged operator is established. The frozen contract repeats this boundary. No applicable explicit grant was found in the inspected dev/studio instructions.

Thus none of (a) loop attachment/private mount, (b) dedicated non-shared Docker-daemon operation, or (c) task-specific systemd/helper installation/activation is presently bound to an authorized operator. Docker-group/root-equivalent access and generic delegation do not fill this gap.

The concrete missing items are a named operator's acknowledgement, TJ's task-specific privileged authority or a citable existing configured grant, and an approved privilege/authentication route for that exact helper. The previously recorded sudo route requires a password; it was not probed again. A missing authorization is not solved by supplying a password. No credential was obtained, requested, printed or transmitted.

Remedy ownership: studio lead gathers the complete source-reviewed reversible command packet and reconciles authority; Meownero Platform `92a7b4f2-787b-4cbb-954e-46831397ab09` qualifies it. If no existing explicit grant can be supplied, **TJ must designate/authorize the privileged operator and its narrow authentication route**; studio lead batches that ask. P2P/Mining remains sole source writer. This is not a request to TJ from this invocation.

## 2. Five bindings: existing versus proposed

All proposed names, sizes and operations below are **unexecuted, unqualified proposals**, not identities or grants.

### Binding 1 — persistent hard-bounded control allocation

Exists now: no qualifying allocation is identified in the standing facility record or frozen bindings. Control path, owner/mode, backing device/inode, mounted device/mount ID/namespace inode, capacity and custodian are therefore **unbound**. Root ext4 device 66306 is only a known backing primitive, not a control allocation.

Proposed preparation: select a canonical private task root; exclusively create and fully allocate a fixed **C = 1 GiB** ext4 backing, format it, attach an explicitly selected unused loop device, and mount it in the operator-owned private namespace. Proposed backing owner root:root/mode0600, parent and control mount root:root/mode0700; exact subordinate access must follow the reviewed helper design. Record real path, device/inode, nlink, length/allocated bytes, filesystem UUID/capacity, loop identity, mount ID, namespace inode and custody receipt after authorized creation. Do not choose a fabricated loop number, mount ID or inode now.

Before first admission, reserve and fsync the exact grant/attempt/commit/artifact/bootstrap slot, local-ledger capacity and bounded log/export space. Proposed internal C maxima: 64 MiB state/slots/ledger, 256 MiB logs, 512 MiB retained export, 192 MiB ext4 metadata/journal/reserve. Actual format overhead and available payload must fit these ceilings or refuse.

The operator retains the control backing and custody independently of workload teardown. Restart is recovery-only; missing/corrupt state quarantines the grant, never restores eligibility. No automatic deletion, repair, replacement, rollback or slot rearm is permitted. Retention lasts until explicit authorized disposition; bounded ENOSPC must stop new work without erasing quarantine. No second writable backup is assumed.

Separately bound workload: a distinct fixed non-growable **W = 11 GiB** ext4 backing, exclusively helper-controlled, with every workload writer confined to that filesystem. Work cannot write C, its backing or the host parent. Preserve first-admission -> durable quarantine -> local consumption -> workload provisioning; do not create/format/mount W before durable consumption. Its later allocation, loop, mount and all setup count in the runtime budget. Two separate fixed filesystems are a proposed change from this frozen single-filesystem helper, requiring source reconciliation and Platform qualification, not a current supported binding.

Both loop/mount operations and privileged confinement require the missing named operator grant. Root-owned files alone do not enforce confinement against a root helper; its reviewed capability/seccomp/namespace policy must prevent extension, external writes and escape.

### Binding 2 — 15-GiB split and preparation accounting

Exists now: no reserved split, accounted preparation receipt or enforceable task-wide allocation/custody binding.

Proposed hard occupied-capacity envelope, in binary GiB:
- C = 1 GiB fixed control, including its filesystem metadata.
- W = 11 GiB fixed workload, including its filesystem metadata, Docker/containerd/shim stores, configs, private data, temporary files, generated/source copies and workload-side export staging.
- A <= 2 GiB for the sole archive-preparation output/temporary allocation; after sealing, the same bytes become the read-only archive, not a second copy.
- O <= 1 GiB for every other preparation artifact, directory metadata, installation/log/evidence staging and additional copy. Anything otherwise writable must be enumerated and charged here or to C/W/A.
- C + W + A + O <= 15 GiB = 16,106,127,360 bytes; C and W positive. Unused allowance does not silently enlarge W. Backings and the filesystems they contain are charged once, not twice; extra copies are charged separately. If the exact image or overhead does not fit, refuse and return for a qualified revised split. No full-15-GiB workload plus external control state.

Source/toolchain inputs may be existing read-only inputs only. No writable host /tmp, journal sink, default Docker store, extra tmpfs/memfd, cache, daemon state or uncounted receipt/export copy is allowed. The requested board handback file and board comment are administrative reporting, not proposed runtime control storage.

Proposed pre-attempt preparation, requiring review and exact operator authorization:
- Control allocation/format/private mount/reserved slot: <=1 CPU, 512 MiB RAM, no swap, 32 PIDs, 300 seconds, <=1.5 GiB cumulative writes.
- Sole immutable archive preparation and provenance verification: <=1 CPU, 1 GiB RAM, no swap, 64 PIDs, 900 seconds, <=2 GiB output and cumulative writes; producer/exporter resource use must be included, not hidden in an unbounded shared daemon.
- Preparation logs/manifests/metadata and any installation staging: <=0.5 GiB additional cumulative writes. Combined preparation <=1200 seconds sequentially, <=4 GiB cumulative writes and <=4 GiB occupied task capacity before W. Caps include children, helper and observer; use an independently enforced overall parent ceiling no greater than 2 CPU/4 GiB/no swap/256 PIDs. A budget without an enforcing supervisor/custodian is not qualified.
- The acknowledged privileged operator owns preparation custody and readback. P2P supplies reviewed source; Platform qualifies actual enforcement. No such supervisor is presently bound.

In-attempt W allocation/format/mount, namespace setup, daemon startup, image load/verification, native work, recovery and export all remain within aggregate 2 CPU/4 GiB/no swap/256 PIDs, one compiler job, <=15 GiB occupied writable capacity and 4500=3600+600+300 seconds. Preserve the original write limit as well; these capacity figures do not silently redefine it as cumulative-I/O permission. Preparation and runtime receipts must report both peak allocation and actual writes. Whether 11 GiB is enough is unproven and must be qualified, not asserted.

### Binding 3 — manager/helper/systemd/delegation/private namespace

Exists now: inspectable partial source at the exact commit:
- `vanguard/network/profile_manager.py`: RootfulManager, GrantJournal, AdmissionGate; SHA256 `137425a395854119c29362d254aa3af7b5bd961644cade93e83764b1d28cec41`.
- `vanguard/network/profile_helper.py`: command_manifest/unit_contract only; SHA256 `5b995f2e15bf08ce74ad23d12b1499175544eef30dc5583a03687f1eabeec454`.
- Manifest state `PARTIAL_SOURCE_ADAPTER_NOT_HOST_READY`; privileged helper server, concrete operator and legacy inner atomic-create binding are null. run_controller deliberately refuses.

The standing record identifies systemd 255.4-1ubuntu8.18 and user@1000 Delegate=yes under `/user.slice/user-1000.slice/user@1000.service`. Those are not a task-specific manager, install authority or qualified interface. No actual helper binary/version, unit name/ExecStart, delegated task cgroup, namespace handle, custody/deadline owner or final-observer identity is bound.

Proposed preparation/source: P2P implements the missing server and wiring only against an exact operator-approved interface; freeze new source/version/hash before installation. Then the authorized operator may install a task-only reviewed unit/helper and prepare the private namespace under existing delegation, without changing shared caller units. Installation/activation requires the missing grant, separate setup request and Platform qualification.

Required qualification: actual independent same-open-description PID1 FD-store custody readback, not sendmsg/barrier success; surviving namespace reference; PID1 restart into recovery-only mode retaining original absolute deadlines; independent enforcement at origin+4500; recovery surviving work OOM/kill; final observer after recovery exits; independently witnessed final release. Proposed aggregate work <=3840 MiB/224 PIDs and control/recovery/observer <=256 MiB/32 PIDs shares the existing 4-GiB/256-PID ceiling. PID1/kernel FD-store overhead must also be bounded/accounted inside the accepted total; the frozen source does not supply that enforcement. No generic systemd claim resolves it.

### Binding 4 — immutable offline image archive

Exists now: no qualifying archive was identified by the earlier bounded pass; no later custodian supplied one in the inspected handoff. Custodian, provenance, path, device/inode, length, archive hash and immutable/read-only custody are **unbound**. This is not a global-absence claim. Required image remains `sha256:10a15debf7142412a29cb4cd77fd1bdfa6081b24b94a867b3c19e62ec7061c3e`, linux/amd64. Its image ID is not the archive SHA256. The verified attachment above is source, not this image.

Proposed preparation: studio lead identifies the actual image custodian; that custodian supplies an already immutable archive or, under explicit export authority, creates one bounded output in A, verifies exact image/config/layer provenance and architecture, hashes all archive bytes, records path/device/inode/nlink/length, and seals it under operator-controlled read-only custody unavailable for workload mutation. No guessed exporter endpoint or custodian is asserted. The producer/exporter and all temporary copies must fit Binding 2's caps; if a shared producer cannot be accounted, it is not an acceptable preparation route. No pull/save/export/import was performed. Later load uses only the dedicated daemon and is charged inside the attempt. Archive creation authority is not present in this read-only handoff.

### Binding 5 — private inherited authenticated admission/create

Exists now: source-level unnamed AF_UNIX/SOCK_SEQPACKET/SO_PASSCRED client and AdmissionGate ordering; no installed authenticated helper server, actual inherited FD, endpoint owner or permitted privileged operation binding. Four populated JSON objects would not establish them.

Proposed interface: operator-owned helper creates/inherits unnamed one-use endpoints; verifies each SCM_CREDENTIALS sender PID/start identity, CLOEXEC and absolute deadlines; bounds frames <=64 KiB and closes rejected unsolicited FDs. Bind grant, attempt, ledger identity/digest, commit, input/source-packet artifact digest, exact image/archive, bootstrap, exact create argv, and original lock device66306/inode657237 plus its held same-description witness. No pathname/public/shared socket or reusable bearer token.

Permitted helper operations, only after a later exact grant: retain with independent custody acknowledgement; first complete admission; durable quarantine; scoped provisioning of its own resources; one atomic second observation-and-create; recovery of exact owned resources; final post-exit observation. The helper consumes even a refused request before checks, prevalidates/hashes create inputs before observation, rechecks original FD and performs complete fresh memory/disk/load/process/container/lock observation plus its own exact create within five seconds; stale/ambiguous/repeated requests fail permanently. Bind actual operator/server source/hash and integrate the legacy inner seam before claiming availability. No original lock was acquired or opened in this turn.

## Disposition and next owners

This is an authority/binding answer, not another facility inventory, accepted host setup or runtime acceptance. No complete privileged operator binding is available. Needs TJ: **yes only if the studio lead cannot supply an already explicit grant**—designation/authorization of the narrow privileged operator and approved authentication route. Do not ask TJ for a password in chat. Studio lead batches that decision after the concrete source-reviewed setup packet is ready; Platform qualifies changed exact inputs, not unchanged evidence. P2P may reconcile the section-15 source fit/refusal work under the conditional continuation, but must stop at absent concrete helper/operator prerequisites rather than inventing them.

Keep bootstrap null, qualified table empty, runtime rows NOT_RUN, Core stage `bab7a7aa-fe78-4cc9-8822-2b3d1e9b35de`, decision `52c7a4e3-be38-4338-bd39-2da99c28b85d`/changes-requested count1 and subsequent Security. A separate exact runtime grant and two complete fresh admissions remain necessary. Public launch stays disabled.

No sudo probe, credential access, service installation/activation, provisioning, loop attachment/mount, image export/import, source edit, lock acquisition, grant consumption, workload, ZFS operation/proposal or message to TJ occurred.
